title: Corpus Luteum and Uterine Artery Doppler With Serum P and CA125 in Threatened Abortion
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether assessing color doppler of corpus luteum and uterine artery is useful in predicting patients who will complete pregnancy. The investigators will add to this the usefulness of serum progesterone and CA125 in prediction.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with pregnancy between 8 to 20 weeks of gestation,
* who were diagnosed with threatened abortion.

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with multiple pregnancies,
* molar pregnancy,
* ectopic pregnancy,
* amenorrhea with different etiologies of pregnancy,
* maternal history of systemic diseases and uterine anatomic abnormalities
* patients who did not have their outcome data through week 20 of gestation due to relocation.
study_population: Pregnant females \>8 weeks but \< 20 weeks gestation. They are presenting with a complaint of threatened abortion to our outpatient ANC clinic.
